summary: Verified v2 browser sync script for LinkedIn connections. Backend GET /api/li-search/browser-script now returns 3998-char script with a[href*="/in/"] anchor selector, closest() DOM walker, aria-hidden name extraction, and batch-of-100 push loop (slice(i, i+100)). Instructions expanded from 6 to 7 steps and include scrolling guidance. POST /connections/push, GET /connections (with keyword search & upsert idempotency), /api/health, and /api/li-search/posts (>=20 posts) all regression-pass. Frontend: agent gate (Access + Agent@2024!) works, Messaging tab loads, 'Show Sync Script' reveals the v2 script in [data-testid=sync-script-textarea] containing all required tokens; all 7 instruction steps visible in UI. 6/6 real pytest tests passed (cleanup helper had env-var quoting issue and was executed manually — deleted 2 TEST connections).
critical_code_review_comments: Script still contains legacy 'span.mn-connection-card__name' as a fallback name selector — intentional fallback but worth documenting as a fallback in a comment.
linkedin_search.py remains ~1475 lines; still should be modularized (carry-over from iter 8).
Instruction list in UI is not rendered as <ol><li> — steps are visible plain text lines. If you want semantic list styling/testing, wrap in ol/li in LinkedInSearch.jsx sync-section.

context_for_next_testing_agent: v2 sync script verified end-to-end. Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_connections_sync.py requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported before pytest run (or use `export $(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env)`). test_cleanup_test_connections uses os.environ.get('MONGO_URL') which fails when quoted in .env — use python-dotenv's dotenv_values as workaround. Consider updating conftest to load both env files.
rca of the issue: N/A — all requested v2 script assertions and regressions pass.
